title: Roast Chicken Thighs with Root Vegetables
summary: A simple British-style traybake with crisp chicken thighs and sweet, caramelised root vegetables. It’s hearty, savoury and ideal for an easy dinner.

ingredients.name: beetroot, peeled and cut into wedges

steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Put the potatoes, carrots, beetroot and red onion into a large roasting tin with the garlic, olive oil, thyme, rosemary, salt and black pepper. Toss well so everything is lightly coated.
Roast the vegetables for 20 minutes, stirring once halfway through, until they start to soften and take on a little colour.
Pat the chicken thighs dry, season them with a little extra salt and pepper, then nestle them on top of the vegetables, skin-side up.
Return the tray to the oven and roast for 35 to 40 minutes more, until the chicken skin is golden and crisp and the thighs are cooked through.
If needed, roast for an extra 5 minutes to deepen the colour. Rest for 5 minutes before serving so the juices settle.
